item.title: The incoming class of U.S. senators is full of historic firsts
item.description: From the first Native American elected to the U.S. Senate and the first Muslim who will join the upper chamber to the Senate's first Paralympian, voters elected historic candidates in the midterms.
item.content:encoded:
From the first Native American elected to the U.S. Senate and the first Muslim who will join the upper chamber to the Senate's first Paralympian, voters elected historic candidates in the midterms.

item.title: No one knows how many ballots are outstanding in Mississippi's Senate race
item.description: The razor-thin margin between GOP Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith and Democrat Scott Colom is shining a light on an election process in Mississippi that is among the slowest and most decentralized in the U.S.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Judge halts construction of Trump's arch. And, Labor Department to release jobs report
item.description: A judge has blocked construction of Trump's arch moments after it won federal approval to proceed. And, the Labor Department is set to release the latest jobs report today, a day after stocks plunged.

item.title: Dearborn, Michigan, mayor on city's record turnout and the election of Abdul El-Sayed
item.description: NPR host Leila Fadel speaks with Abdullah Hammoud, the mayor of Dearborn, Michigan, about why his city turned out in record numbers to elect Abdul El-Sayed to the U.S. Senate.

item.title: Voters under 30 helped drive Tuesday's blue wave
item.description: Young voters played a large role in Democratic wins in this week's midterms. People under 30 voted blue at much higher rates than in 2024.

item.title: A judge blocked construction of Trump's arch at the 11th hour. What's next?
item.description: The Trump administration had hoped to begin construction immediately after a federal panel approved its arch late Thursday. Overnight, the judge issued an order blocking work for 14 days.
item.content:encoded:

(Image credit: Tom Brenner)

item.title: These are the races in the House and Senate that haven't been called yet
